newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Avantel pays debt with new loan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Avantel pays debt with new loan.

text.p: Mexican telephone company Avantel SA has used part of a new loan to pay off $150 million of an outstanding bridge loan, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
Avantel in February negotiated a 13-year, $481 million loan with the U.S. Eximbank and the Export Development Corp of Canada and had to date received some $218 million of the money, it said.
"Avantel paid the entirety of the $150 million outstanding from a bridge loan taken out with BankAmerica, Swiss Bank, ABN Amro and Toronto Dominion," it said.
Avantel is a joint venture between MCI Communications Corp and Mexico's Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival. ((-- Daniel Peerez-Whitaker, Monterrey bureau +528 345-7617))
